ambient_events: The lead diesel changes note as something upstairs draws harder, and settles again.
Fuel drums are stacked three deep and stencilled with a running count. The count is lower than it was.
Every mount, strap and pipe hanger in here is doubled. Noise travels further than light down here.
description: A hot, deafening concrete box holding two old diesels and a bank of cells, on rubber mounts, behind a wall packed with rock wool. The Watch draw nothing from the city grid — not a watt, not ever, because a load where nobody lives is a fingerprint the Architect can read from a substation ledger. They burn fuel they have to carry down here by hand instead, and that is the single largest cost of being invisible.
name: The Generator Vault
